'''D-0T''' was a blue-plated [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who worked for the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
During the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], this droid was working in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] in the [[Power control room/Legends|power control room]] when [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] posse entered the room. D-0T was destroyed by [[HELIOS-3E/Legends|HELIOS-3E]], one of Bane's [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droids]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
D-0T's character model appears to have been reused for [[Dantum Roohd/Legends|Dantum Roohd's]] protocol droid in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|Clone Wars]] episode "[[Duchess of Mandalore]]." The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was present with Dantum when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was addressing whether to send [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] or not.<ref name="Duchess of Mandalore">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>

[[File:DantumRoohdProtocolDroid-DoM.png|thumb|left|150px|The dark blue protocol droid owned by Dantum Roohd.]]
